 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Anju Jha, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Nand Kumar, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Harish Kumar
 Oral Order
2 01-12-2025

Heard learned Advocate for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner, who happens to husband of O.P. No.2 is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case bearing C.R. No.630 of 2023, wherein cognizance has been taken for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 498A and 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Learned Advocate for the petitioner submitted that there is complete denial that the petitioner is the husband of O.P. No.2; moreover, there is a delay in filing of the complaint case also.

4. Let notice be issued to O.P. No.2 under both Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.81683 of 2025(2)
dt.01-12-2025 registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process, the requisite of which must be filed, preferably within a period of two weeks from today.
5. Re-notify this case after valid service of notice upon O.P. No.2 or on her appearance or on 12.01.2026, whichever is earlier.
